questions.question: Explain the difference between the face value and the place value of the digit 3 in 4 736 and in 3 476.
questions.expected_answer: The face value is the digit itself, so in both numbers it is 3. The place value depends on position: in 4 736 the 3 is in the tens place and is worth 30; in 3 476 the 3 is in the thousands place and is worth 3 000.

questions.question: Write 2 305 in expanded notation and explain what the zero tells you.
questions.expected_answer: 2 305 equals 2 000 plus 300 plus 0 plus 5, usually written 2 000 plus 300 plus 5. The zero tells you there are no tens, and it must be kept in the number so that the 2 and the 3 stay in the thousands and hundreds places.

questions.question: A school's fund-raising total changes from R4 736 to R4 836 and later to R5 836. Explain how reading the digits tells you how much was added each time.
questions.expected_answer: From R4 736 to R4 836 only the hundreds digit changed, from 7 to 8, so R100 was added. From R4 836 to R5 836 only the thousands digit changed, from 4 to 5, so R1 000 was added. The place of the changed digit tells the size of the change.
